entities.summary: Augustin Daniel Belliard, comte Belliard et de l'Empire was a French general who played a significant role in the Napoleonic Wars. Born in France, he rose through the ranks of the French military during the early 19th century, distinguishing himself in various battles against the British and their allies. Belliard's military career was marked by his loyalty to Napoleon and his dedication to the French Empire. However, his fortunes shifted with the fall of Napoleon, and he eventually found himself on the wrong side of history, fighting against the very forces he once served. Despite his complex legacy, Belliard remains an important figure in the history of the Napoleonic Wars, embodying the contradictions of loyalty, duty, and survival in the face of an uncertain future. His name is still remembered today as a testament to the enduring power of human resilience in the face of adversity.
